title: MpiH3ImageToVideo - blank-tolerant i2v conditioning
description: Core's MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo cannot take a connected-but-empty first_frame/last_frame, so the fl2va workflow carries a four-way boolean lattice (four node copies, four packers, has_img1/has_img2/is_i2v). Wrap it the way MpiH3References (h3.py:233) wraps ref2v: flat always-present optional inputs, _is_blank_image() drops None and the 1x1 loader sentinel, conditioning delegated to core's execute. Also unblocks rebuilding i2v conditioning at upscaled dimensions for the latent-upscaler refine pass, which today would mean duplicating the lattice.
